reason: Setting the target origin to '*' in window.postMessage allows any origin to receive the message, which can lead to information disclosure if sensitive data is included in the message.
attack_vector: An attacker can inject a script into a different origin and listen for messages sent with window.postMessage, intercepting any sensitive data.
